questions: When N is less than len(CATEGORIES), should the categories be sampled without replacement (so each selected category appears exactly once) or could they be sampled with replacement (potentially duplicates)?

Should the scatter plot include a legend by default, or is that left to the caller?
What should happen if CATEGORIES list is empty? Should it raise an error or produce an empty 'category' column?
Should the random uniform distribution for x and y be over [0,1) (half-open) or [0,1] (closed)?
When N=0, should the function still create a scatter plot (with empty data) or skip plotting?
Should the Axes object have any specific labels (xlabel, ylabel, title) set, or be completely bare except for the scatter points?
When N >= len(CATEGORIES), after concatenating guaranteed and remaining categories, should the final shuffle use the same random seed as the other random operations?
